import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 600;
    static long mod;
    static Mint[] a = new Mint[MAXN];
    static Mint[] c = new Mint[MAXN];
    static Mint[][] comb = new Mint[MAXN][MAXN];
    static Mint[][][] dp = new Mint[MAXN][MAXN][2];
    static Mint[][][] dpc = new Mint[MAXN][MAXN][2];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long m = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        mod = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());

        generateCombination();

        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            a[i] = new Mint(0);
            c[i] = new Mint(0);
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXN; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = new Mint(0);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXN; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
                    dp[i][j][k] = new Mint(0);
                    dpc[i][j][k] = new Mint(0);
                }
            }
        }

        a[0] = new Mint(0);
        c[0] = new Mint(1);
        a[1] = new Mint(0);
        c[1] = new Mint(2);

        for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) {
            Mint tmp = new Mint(0);
            Mint tmpc = new Mint(0);
            for (int l = 0; l <= i; l++) {
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                tmp = tmp.add(
                        c[l].mul(c[r])
                                .mul(new Mint(s1(1, l) + 1, true))
                                .mul(new Mint(s1(1, r) + 1, true))
                                .mul(comb[i - 1][l])
                                .add(
                                        (a[l].mul(c[r]).add(a[r].mul(c[l])))
                                                .mul(comb[i - 1][l])
                                                .mul(new Mint(i + 1, true))
                                )
                );
                tmpc = tmpc.add(
                        c[l].mul(c[r])
                                .mul(new Mint(i + 1, true))
                                .mul(comb[i - 1][l])
                );
            }
            a[i] = tmp;
            c[i] = tmpc;
        }

        // Initialize dpc[0][0][0]=1;
        dpc[0][0][0] = new Mint(1);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                if (j > i) continue;
                dpc[i][j][0] = dpc[i - 1][j][0].add(dpc[i - 1][j][1]);
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                    dpc[i][j][1] = dpc[i][j][1].add(c[k].mul(comb[j][k]).mul(dpc[i - k][j - k][0]));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                if (j > i) continue;
                dp[i][j][0] = dp[i - 1][j][0].add(dp[i - 1][j][1]);
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                    dp[i][j][1] = dp[i][j][1].add(
                            a[k].mul(comb[j][k]).mul(dpc[i - k][j - k][0])
                                    .add(dp[i - k][j - k][0].mul(c[k]).mul(comb[j][k]))
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dp[(int) n][(int) m][0].add(dp[(int) n][(int) m][1]).x);
    }

    static void generateCombination() {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            comb[i][0] = new Mint(1);
            comb[i][i] = new Mint(1);
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j - 1].add(comb[i - 1][j]);
            }
        }
    }

    // s1 function for sum of integer range
    static long s1(long l, long r) {
        if (l > r) return 0;
        return (l + r) * (r - l + 1) / 2;
    }

    static class Mint {
        long x;

        Mint(long x) {
            this.x = (x % mod + mod) % mod;
        }

        Mint(long x, boolean direct) {
            this.x = (x % mod + mod) % mod;
        }

        public Mint add(Mint b) {
            return new Mint(this.x + b.x);
        }

        public Mint subtract(Mint b) {
            return new Mint(this.x - b.x);
        }

        public Mint multiply(Mint b) {
            return new Mint(this.x * b.x);
        }

        public Mint divide(Mint b) {
            return this.multiply(b.inv());
        }

        public Mint pow(long b) {
            if (b == 0) return new Mint(1);
            Mint tmp = this.pow(b / 2);
            return b % 2 == 1 ? tmp.multiply(tmp).multiply(this) : tmp.multiply(tmp);
        }

        public Mint inv() {
            // Extended Euclidean Algorithm for modular inverse
            long a = this.x, m = mod, m0 = m, t, q;
            long x0 = 0, x1 = 1;
            if (m == 1) return new Mint(0);
            while (a > 1) {
                q = a / m;
                t = m;
                m = a % m;
                a = t;
                t = x0;
                x0 = x1 - q * x0;
                x1 = t;
            }
            if (x1 < 0) x1 += m0;
            return new Mint(x1);
        }
    }
}
